key: COREY: Right. You're done.
en: COREY: Right. You're done.
ja: コーリー: よし。もう終わりだ。

key: You've served me well, but now you're free.
en: You've served me well, but now you're free.
ja: よく仕えてくれた。だが、もう自由にしていい。

key: Get lost.
en: Get lost.
ja: 消えろ。

key: COREY: That means you too. You're not special.
en: COREY: That means you too. You're not special.
ja: コーリー: お前もだ。特別扱いはしない。

key: Get a move on.
en: Get a move on.
ja: さっさと行け。

key: COREY: I said get lost already.
en: COREY: I said get lost already.
ja: コーリー: 消えろと言っている。

key: You're not wanted here anymore!
en: You're not wanted here anymore!
ja: もうここにお前は要らない!

key: COREY: With that out of the way, I won't be needing these anymore.
en: COREY: With that out of the way, I won't be needing these anymore.
ja: コーリー: これで片づいた。もうこれらは必要ない。

key: Corey threw the Poké Balls away!
en: Corey threw the Poké Balls away!
ja: コーリーはモンスターボールを投げ捨てた!

key: COREY: I never wanted it to be this way.
en: COREY: I never wanted it to be this way.
ja: コーリー: こんな結末を望んでいたわけではない。

key: If I had had a choice, I never would have joined Team Meteor.
en: If I had had a choice, I never would have joined Team Meteor.
ja: 選べるものならば、メテオ団に加わることなどなかっただろう。

key: I was cursed by my own luck.
en: I was cursed by my own luck.
ja: 私は、自らの運に呪われていた。

key: There was a ring with a single, brilliant ruby.
en: There was a ring with a single, brilliant ruby.
ja: ひとつの見事なルビーをあしらった指輪があった。

key: I purchased it from a traveling merchant some time ago.
en: I purchased it from a traveling merchant some time ago.
ja: 以前、旅の商人から買い求めたものだ。

key: I was never one for jewelry myself, but it was the most dazzling ring I had ever seen.
en: I was never one for jewelry myself, but it was the most dazzling ring I had ever seen.
ja: 私自身は宝飾品に興味などなかったが、それは今まで見た中で最も輝かしい指輪だった。

key: I decided that I would introduce that ring to what true beauty was.
en: I decided that I would introduce that ring to what true beauty was.
ja: その指輪に、本当の美しさというものを教えてやろうと思ったのだ。

key: I promised it to my love, and she accepted.
en: I promised it to my love, and she accepted.
ja: 愛する人にそれを贈ると約束し、彼女は受け取ってくれた。

key: But luck is never one-sided.
en: But luck is never one-sided.
ja: だが、運というものは、片方だけには傾かない。

key: Back then, I was happy.
en: Back then, I was happy.
ja: あの頃、私は幸せだった。

key: I was naive.
en: I was naive.
ja: 世間知らずだった。

key: Shortly after we married, my wife became pregnant.
en: Shortly after we married, my wife became pregnant.
ja: 結婚してほどなく、妻は身ごもった。

key: That was the beginning of the end.
en: That was the beginning of the end.
ja: それが、終わりの始まりだった。

key: She did not survive Heather's birth.
en: She did not survive Heather's birth.
ja: 妻は、ヘザーを産んで生き延びることができなかった。

key: I was told that she died because of a mechanical error during the delivery.
en: I was told that she died because of a mechanical error during the delivery.
ja: 出産時の機械の不具合で命を落としたと聞かされた。

key: Unlucky.
en: Unlucky.
ja: 不運だった。

key: But that wasn't all there was to the story.
en: But that wasn't all there was to the story.
ja: だが、話はそれだけではなかった。

key: I would later learn that the doctor assigned to her had been dispatched by Team Meteor specifically to obtain that ring.
en: I would later learn that the doctor assigned to her had been dispatched by Team Meteor specifically to obtain that ring.
ja: 後になって知ったことだが、彼女を担当した医師は、あの指輪を手に入れるためだけにメテオ団から送り込まれていたのだ。

key: So I found him.
en: So I found him.
ja: だから私は、その男を捜し出した。

key: I carved for him regrets that he would not soon forget.
en: I carved for him regrets that he would not soon forget.
ja: そう簡単には忘れられない後悔を、その身に刻んでやった。

key: And I seized the ring.
en: And I seized the ring.
ja: そして、指輪を奪い返した。

key: But in the end, I failed.
en: But in the end, I failed.
ja: だが、結局は失敗に終わった。

key: Because he had Heather.
en: Because he had Heather.
ja: 奴が、ヘザーを押さえていたからだ。

key: The ring for her life.
en: The ring for her life.
ja: 指輪と、娘の命の引き換え。

key: But there were no promises there.
en: But there were no promises there.
ja: だが、そこに約束などなかった。

key: Instead, I made a deal.
en: Instead, I made a deal.
ja: 代わりに、私は取引をした。

key: My service for her safety.
en: My service for her safety.
ja: 娘の安全と引き換えに、私の忠誠を。

key: And as a bonus, I would keep the ring.
en: And as a bonus, I would keep the ring.
ja: そのうえで、指輪は私の手元に残すことにした。

key: To me, it was the last token of our happiness.
en: To me, it was the last token of our happiness.
ja: 私にとって、それは二人の幸せの最後の証だった。

key: Heather was the last joy we never got to share.
en: Heather was the last joy we never got to share.
ja: ヘザーは、私たちが分かち合えなかった最後の喜びだった。

key: But I was not afforded that luxury.
en: But I was not afforded that luxury.
ja: だが、私にそのぜいたくは許されなかった。

key: That was my own weakness.
en: That was my own weakness.
ja: それは、私自身の弱さだった。

key: I was afraid of losing her like I did her mother.
en: I was afraid of losing her like I did her mother.
ja: 母親を失ったように、あの子まで失うのが怖かった。

key: Her mother was a beautiful, intelligent woman.
en: Her mother was a beautiful, intelligent woman.
ja: あの子の母は、美しく賢い女性だった。

key: Her equal does not exist.
en: Her equal does not exist.
ja: あれほどの女性は、他にいない。

key: This, I am sure of.
en: This, I am sure of.
ja: それだけは確かだ。

key: When I was with her, I was complete.
en: When I was with her, I was complete.
ja: 彼女と共にいるとき、私は満たされていた。

key: I was happy.
en: I was happy.
ja: 幸せだった。

key: She left this world in exchange for Heather.
en: She left this world in exchange for Heather.
ja: 彼女は、ヘザーと引き換えにこの世を去った。

key: A chance mechanical error took her life during childbirth.
en: A chance mechanical error took her life during childbirth.
ja: 出産中の、たまたまの機械の不具合が、彼女の命を奪ったのだ。

key: It was then I learned how cold reality truly was.
en: It was then I learned how cold reality truly was.
ja: あのとき私は、現実がどれほど冷たいものかを知った。

key: Just as soon as one finds what they've always sought, it is ripped apart from them forever.
en: Just as soon as one finds what they've always sought, it is ripped apart from them forever.
ja: ずっと求めていたものを、ようやく手にしたと思った瞬間、それは永遠に奪い去られてしまう。

key: I vowed never to let Heather believe any different.
en: I vowed never to let Heather believe any different.
ja: ヘザーには、決して違う考えを抱かせまいと誓った。

key: I vowed not to lose her too.
en: I vowed not to lose her too.
ja: あの子まで失うまいと誓った。

key: Life is cruel and nothing more.
en: Life is cruel and nothing more.
ja: 人生とは、ただ残酷なだけのものだ。

key: I thought, by raising her knowing this, I could spare her the torment I suffered.
en: I thought, by raising her knowing this, I could spare her the torment I suffered.
ja: それを知った上であの子を育てれば、私が味わった苦しみを与えずに済むと思っていた。

key: But all I did was hurt her myself.
en: But all I did was hurt her myself.
ja: だが、結局は私自身があの子を傷つけただけだった。

key: And now because of it, she's gone.
en: And now because of it, she's gone.
ja: そして今、そのせいであの子はいなくなった。

key: There's nothing left.
en: There's nothing left.
ja: もう、何も残っていない。

key: I cannot return to Team Meteor-- they believe I am a traitor.
en: I cannot return to Team Meteor-- they believe I am a traitor.
ja: メテオ団には戻れない――裏切り者だと思われている。

key: But I cannot turn against them, since my identity has been revealed.
en: But I cannot turn against them, since my identity has been revealed.
ja: だが、正体が知られてしまった以上、彼らに逆らうこともできない。

key: If not to the police, then to that woman.
en: If not to the police, then to that woman.
ja: 警察でなければ、あの女に。

key: If not to you, then to that woman.
en: If not to you, then to that woman.
ja: お前でなければ、あの女に。

key: She clearly knew who I was in the first place.
en: She clearly knew who I was in the first place.
ja: あの女は、そもそも最初から私の正体を知っていたのだからな。

key: And now I cannot even protect the one thing I sought to.
en: And now I cannot even protect the one thing I sought to.
ja: そして今、私は守ろうとしたただひとつのものすら守れずにいる。

key: One wrong move and our lives will be wagered against each other's again.
en: One wrong move and our lives will be wagered against each other's again.
ja: ひとつでも間違えば、また互いの命がはかりにかけられることになる。

key: ...I won't let that happen.
en: ...I won't let that happen.
ja: ……そんなことは、二度とさせない。

key: \PN.
en: \PN.
ja: \PN。

key: Heather has the ring.
en: Heather has the ring.
ja: 指輪はヘザーが持っている。

key: She will be hunted for it.
en: She will be hunted for it.
ja: それを狙って、あの子は追われることになるだろう。

key: Please, watch over her for me.
en: Please, watch over her for me.
ja: 頼む、あの子を見守ってやってくれ。

key: And, one more thing--
en: And, one more thing--
ja: それと、もうひとつ――

key: Embedded underneath the jewel of the ring is a small data chip.
en: Embedded underneath the jewel of the ring is a small data chip.
ja: 指輪の宝石の下には、小さなデータチップが埋め込まれている。

key: In it, you'll find no small amount of information on Team Meteor, their projects, and bases of operation.
en: In it, you'll find no small amount of information on Team Meteor, their projects, and bases of operation.
ja: そこには、メテオ団とその計画、拠点についてのかなりの情報が入っている。

key: Consider it payment for the burden I leave you with.
en: Consider it payment for the burden I leave you with.
ja: お前に背負わせる重荷への、対価だと思ってくれ。

key: COREY: I no longer have the right to call myself her father.
en: COREY: I no longer have the right to call myself her father.
ja: コーリー: 私にはもう、あの子の父を名乗る資格はない。

key: I wonder if I ever did.
en: I wonder if I ever did.
ja: 最初から、あったのかどうかすらわからないが。

key: COREY: I've waited so long just to feel the wind on my cheek again.
en: COREY: I've waited so long just to feel the wind on my cheek again.
ja: コーリー: もう一度、ほおに風を感じるためだけに、ずいぶん長く待ったものだ。

key: I wanted to go chasing the horizon with you one more time...
en: I wanted to go chasing the horizon with you one more time...
ja: もう一度、お前と一緒に地平線を追いかけたかった……

key: Fly a little faster, darling...
en: Fly a little faster, darling...
ja: もう少し速く飛んでくれ、頼むよ……

key: Just a little more, and I'd swear we could reach out and touch the moon.
en: Just a little more, and I'd swear we could reach out and touch the moon.
ja: あと少しで、月に手が届きそうな気さえする。

key: ???: Wow, what a moron.
en: ???: Wow, what a moron.
ja: ???: うわ、なんて間抜けなんだ。

key: FERN: Did that dumb-wad really just throw himself off of Beryl Bridge?
en: FERN: Did that dumb-wad really just throw himself off of Beryl Bridge?
ja: ファーン: あのマヌケ、本当にベリル大橋から飛び降りたのか?

key: Sucker's gone for sure.
en: Sucker's gone for sure.
ja: 完全に終わったな。

key: And you're telling me THAT was Borealis?
en: And you're telling me THAT was Borealis?
ja: それで、あれがボレアリスだったって?

key: Looks like Meteor's agent is just a spot on the sidewalk now.
en: Looks like Meteor's agent is just a spot on the sidewalk now.
ja: メテオ団のエージェントも、今じゃ歩道のシミってわけだ。

key: FERN: You probably think I'm heartless, yeah?
en: FERN: You probably think I'm heartless, yeah?
ja: ファーン: オレ様のこと、薄情だと思ってんだろ?

key: But he was still our enemy, remember?
en: But he was still our enemy, remember?
ja: でもよ、あいつはこっちの敵だったんだぜ、忘れたか?

key: And this is just natural selection.
en: And this is just natural selection.
ja: それに、これはただの自然のふるいってやつだ。

key: So some old terrorist goes crazy and throws himself off a bridge...
en: So some old terrorist goes crazy and throws himself off a bridge...
ja: どっかの老いぼれテロリストが、頭おかしくなって橋から飛び降りた……

key: Big deal.
en: Big deal.
ja: だから何だってんだ。

key: But if you're really so concerned about him, why not just go down and find him yourself?
en: But if you're really so concerned about him, why not just go down and find him yourself?
ja: でもよ、そんなに気になるなら、自分で下に行って探してくればいいだろ?

key: FERN: Look.
en: FERN: Look.
ja: ファーン: いいか。

key: He fell into the Lapis Ward, right below us.
en: He fell into the Lapis Ward, right below us.
ja: あいつはラピス区に落ちた、ちょうどこの真下だ。

key: You can get there just going north from Opal Bridge.
en: You can get there just going north from Opal Bridge.
ja: オパール大橋から北へ行けば着くぜ。

key: I mean, I don't see the point, but whatev--
en: I mean, I don't see the point, but whatev--
ja: まあ、意味あるとは思えねーけど、どうでも――

key: FERN: What the hell was that?!
en: FERN: What the hell was that?!
ja: ファーン: 何だよ、今の?!

key: FERN: Yo, \PN! Look over there!
en: FERN: Yo, \PN! Look over there!
ja: ファーン: おい、\PN! あっち見てみろ!

key: That's a huge plume of smoke...
en: That's a huge plume of smoke...
ja: あのでかい煙……

key: I think it's coming from the North Obsidia Ward!
en: I think it's coming from the North Obsidia Ward!
ja: 北オブシディア区から上がってるみたいだぜ!

key: Something's going down and I'm gonna find out what it is.
en: Something's going down and I'm gonna find out what it is.
ja: 何か起きてる、確かめに行くぜ。

key: Later, loser!
en: Later, loser!
ja: じゃあな、負け犬!
